text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle fused with first-person plural subject, launching a divine assertion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: supporting Arabic display used in the prose for this word

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) does two jobs at once: it asserts certainty and places the divine speaker inside the opening particle. Because {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) follows, the subject is not merely introduced but doubled before any predicate appears. That assertion-frame stretches across reviving, writing, and completed enumeration, so the ayah is heard as one declaration of exclusive divine agency. Coming after 36:11, the promise is grounded by the speaker who now names His own action directly.

topics.headline: fused emphatic divine subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that certainty and divine subjecthood are fused before the first verb appears.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle plus suffix as the governed subject, with the following pronoun reinforcing it.

topics.headline: one assertion covers the action chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reviving, recording, and enumeration fall under one emphatic and exclusive divine claim.
topics.reason: The rows cohere with the clause chain: the opening assertion governs the sequence of divine predicates rather than only the first word.

topics.headline: promise grounded by direct declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from promised glad tidings in 36:11 to the divine source who guarantees them in 36:12.
topics.reason: The boundary rows explicitly connect the opening to 36:11 without changing the local grammar.

words.prose: {{ar:نَحْنُ}} ({{tr:naḥnu}}) is not informational padding after {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}). It holds the listener on the agent before {{ar:نُحْىِ}} ({{tr:nuḥyī}}) arrives, making the divine subject explicit where the verb could have carried it implicitly. The detached form also contrasts with the attached suffix of the previous word, so agency is visible first as bound pronoun and then as independent pronoun. Across the boundary, prophetic commission gives way to unmediated divine self-description.

topics.headline: explicit pronoun makes agency restrictive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the apparently repeated pronoun turns emphasis into exclusive agency before the acts are named.
topics.reason: QAC marks the independent pronoun as corroborative emphasis, and the attachment rows place it between the particle subject and verbal predicate.

topics.headline: prophetic mediation drops from view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from what the prophet announces to what the divine speaker Himself declares.
topics.reason: The boundary row is coherent with the surface shift into first-person divine grammar.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect causative life-giving, locally directed to the dead
words.root_gloss_range: life, revivification, vitality, greeting, and living responsiveness; locally narrowed to causing the dead to live

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: supporting Arabic display used in the prose for this word

words.prose: {{ar:نُحْىِ}} ({{tr:nuḥyī}}) carries the divine subject forward inside an imperfect Form IV verb. The form makes the act causative: not simply living, but causing life in another, and the imperfect presents that power as ongoing. Its object, {{ar:ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-mawtā}}), narrows the life-root field to literal revivification while still letting the wider vitality family color what life means. The phrase also opens a Ya Sin thread: dead persons here, dead earth at 36:33, and renewed creation at 36:79 all share the life-against-death pattern.

topics.headline: causative ongoing reversal of death
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first predicate is ongoing divine causation of life, not a static attribute of living.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form IV imperfect with the dead as object, supporting causation and ongoing aspect.

topics.headline: life field remains richer than a label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that resurrection is literal here while the root family still makes life sound like vitality and living responsiveness.
topics.reason: The broader life-family is real, but the local object restricts the active sense to revivification rather than making every family branch equally active.

topics.headline: surah life-death thread begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this life-giving claim starts a pattern that returns with dead earth at 36:33 and renewed creation at 36:79.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete parallels including 2:73, 30:50, 36:33, and 36:79, all compatible with the local life-death polarity.

topics.headline: long-vowel revival cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the stretched sound of the life-giving phrase before it lands on the dead.
topics.reason: The prosodic row adds an audible payoff without altering the lexical sense.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ}} ({{tr:al-mawtā}}) makes the first act concrete by naming the recipients: the dead, not death as an abstraction. Its definiteness lets the word stand as a known class under divine revivification. The m-w-t field adds the weight of stillness and halted motion, so {{ar:نُحْىِ}} ({{tr:nuḥyī}}) is measured by the state it overturns. Wider uses of the death-root prepare the later dead-earth sign at 36:33, but the local object remains human resurrection as the primary sense.

topics.headline: the dead are explicit object-class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the life-giving verb has a definite population of recipients rather than an abstract idea of death.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the direct object of the Form IV verb.

topics.headline: death names the state overturned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb-object antithesis: life is asserted exactly against death.
topics.reason: The life-death pairing is locally grammatical and supported by cooccurrence rows.

topics.headline: human dead prepare wider dead-earth echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local dead-person plural later opens into the dead-earth sign at 36:33, while the ayah itself keeps persons in view.
topics.reason: The broader death field is useful as a surah thread, but the local morphology and object relation prevent making ecological or spiritual death the primary sense here.

words.prose: The first {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links {{ar:نَكْتُبُ}} ({{tr:naktubu}}) to {{ar:نُحْىِ}} ({{tr:nuḥyī}}). Recording is therefore not a detached afterthought; it stands beside reviving as a parallel divine action under the same emphatic subject. The short connector also gives the cadence a small reset, allowing a new beat without breaking the action chain.

topics.headline: life-giving and recording accumulate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that resurrection power and documentary accountability are joined as one cumulative divine self-description.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the conjunction as linking the two imperfect divine verbs.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect divine recording of deeds and traces
words.root_gloss_range: writing, inscribing, decreeing, binding into a record; locally direct active recording
words.prose: {{ar:نَكْتُبُ}} ({{tr:naktubu}}) keeps the divine subject moving into a second imperfect verb. Its object field is split: what they sent forward and their traces are both written. The k-t-b field makes this more than mental knowledge; it is documentary fixing and binding into a durable joined account, while the local Form I keeps the selected act at direct active writing. Variant readings sharpen the point by contrast: the standard surface keeps the divine subject active and present, while passive or future alternatives would shift agency or aspect. The word also contrasts exact divine registration with false human writing in 2:79 and sets up the later total-enumeration formula of 78:29, where counted totality closes as writing.

topics.headline: ongoing recording has a split object field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine writing is ongoing and reaches both sent-forward actions and remaining traces.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the verb both the relative object and the coordinated traces.

topics.headline: writing fixes accountability into record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recording as inscription and binding accountability, while local Form I keeps it direct writing rather than every branch of the root.
topics.reason: The k-t-b field supports writing, decree, and record-making; sewing imagery is a background analogy, not the selected local action.

topics.headline: variants expose agency and timing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that alternative readings would make recording future or passive, while the standard reading keeps it active, divine, and ongoing.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence is useful contrast, but the canonical local parse remains active imperfect first-person plural.

topics.headline: human writing answered by divine record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine recording contrast with false human writing at 2:79 and anticipate the total written count of 78:29.
topics.reason: The supplied intertexts are concrete and preserve the record field without overriding the local verb.

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) supplies the object slot for {{ar:نَكْتُبُ}} ({{tr:naktubu}}), but it does so by opening a relative clause rather than naming a deed category. The following {{ar:قَدَّمُوا۟}} ({{tr:qaddamū}}) completes its content, so the wording gathers whatever they sent ahead without specifying or limiting the inventory. Locally it is relative, not interrogative or negating.

topics.headline: relative object keeps inventory open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of writing is inclusive and unstated until the following verb fills it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence fix the word as a relative object governed by recording and completed by the following verb.

words.prose: {{ar:قَدَّمُوا۟}} ({{tr:qaddamū}}) fills the relative {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) with completed plural action: what they have sent ahead. Its Form II and gemination intensify the forwarding, while the plural suffix leaves the agents broad rather than named. The q-d-m field lets actions feel like things pushed forward into their own future, and the foot or track pressure links naturally with {{ar:ءَاثَٰرَهُمْ}} ({{tr:āthārahum}}) as footprints left behind. Beside that trace word, it forms a temporal pair: deeds sent ahead and traces left behind, the kind of sent-ahead material regretted in 89:24.

topics.headline: completed plural deeds sent ahead
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recorded object includes completed actions already sent forward by a broad plural group.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form II perfect third-person plural verb completing the relative object.

topics.headline: forwarding image pressures the deed field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices actions pictured as advanced ahead, while the local clause keeps the sense in accountable deeds rather than literal feet or oldness.
topics.reason: The root images are semantically relevant, but the local relative object and recording verb select sent-forward actions.

topics.headline: sent-ahead deeds pair with traces
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a temporal structure: what people put ahead of themselves and what remains after them are both recordable.
topics.reason: The row set links the verb to 89:24, the local trace phrase, and a later q-d-m recurrence at 36:39.

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents {{ar:ءَاثَٰرَهُمْ}} ({{tr:āthārahum}}) from being swallowed into the relative clause as if it were only part of what they sent forward. It coordinates traces with {{ar:مَا قَدَّمُوا۟}} ({{tr:mā qaddamū}}), making a two-entry accounting field: actions advanced before them and effects remaining after them.

topics.headline: coordination creates two-entry accounting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that deeds and traces are separated without being detached from the same recording verb.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence coordinate the trace noun with the relative object under the writing verb.

words.prose: {{ar:ءَاثَٰرَهُمْ}} ({{tr:āthārahum}}) extends accountability beyond acts completed before death. The plural noun and the suffix make many traces belong to the same broad agents of {{ar:قَدَّمُوا۟}} ({{tr:qaddamū}}), and the standard accusative reading keeps those traces under {{ar:نَكْتُبُ}} ({{tr:naktubu}}) as a second recorded object. The ʾ-th-r field gives the aftermath a track-like texture: effects can be followed, not just listed, and what people prefer or advance leaves traceable aftermath. Variant case evidence is useful because it shows what the standard reading chooses: not independent traces standing as their own subject, but traces written into the same divine record. The trace field also reverses 43:22, where people follow ancestral traces, and contrasts with the traces of divine mercy in 30:50.

topics.headline: traces belong to the same agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recorded accountability includes plural aftereffects attached back to their makers.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word an accusative coordinated object with a possessive suffix.

topics.headline: trace imagery makes consequences followable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices consequences as footprints, effects, and remains that can be tracked, while local grammar keeps them as recorded aftermath.
topics.reason: The trace field is locally apt; the preference branch shadows the form but does not replace the noun sense.

topics.headline: case variant exposes objecthood choice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a nominative variant would make traces more independent, while the standard reading records them as the second object.
topics.reason: Variant evidence clarifies the grammatical stakes, but the local output follows the standard accusative object parse.

topics.headline: deeds and traces stretch time both ways
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices accountability reaching backward into inherited traces at 43:22 and outward into residual effects, alongside divine mercy traces at 30:50.
topics.reason: The supplied rows provide concrete references and a local temporal pairing with sent-forward deeds.

words.prose: The third {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) marks a scope break. It can still coordinate with the previous divine actions, but it also resumes into a new fronted-object sentence: {{ar:كُلَّ شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:kulla shayʾin}}) moves the discourse from deeds and traces to every thing. The short sound gives the listener a reset before the totalizing phrase arrives.

topics.headline: coordination becomes resumption into totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah widening from human records to universal enumeration while staying inside the divine action chain.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence license a new coordinated enumeration clause with a fronted object.

words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) pulls totality to the front of the clause before {{ar:أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:aḥṣaynāhu}}) names the counting. As a construct head with {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}), it produces open universal inclusion rather than a known limited set. The k-l-l field adds an exhaustion pressure: nothing is left outside the count. A nominative variant would shift the phrase toward a topic, but the standard accusative makes totality the fronted object of completed enumeration, matching the total-enumeration formula in 78:29.

topics.headline: totality is fronted before the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every thing is placed before the verb so total scope is heard before the act of counting.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as accusative fronted object and construct head.

topics.headline: exhaustive inclusion has no exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from deeds and traces to an unbounded total inventory.
topics.reason: The construct with an indefinite complement supports universal inclusion and the exhaustion image strengthens the payoff.

topics.headline: variant and 78:29 clarify the construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 78:29 shares the total-enumeration formula, while the standard local case keeps the phrase as fronted object rather than nominal topic.
topics.reason: Variant evidence is apparatus-level contrast; the local grammatical output follows the accusative object reading.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive complement making the universal quantifier maximally open
words.root_gloss_range: thingness, entity, conceivable object, and will/existence associations; locally any countable thing under total enumeration

words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) completes the construct of {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}). Its indefiniteness keeps the domain open: not every known item from a list, but every thing whatever. The sh-y-ʾ field lets what is willed into thingness also fall under enumeration, yet the local payoff is simpler and stronger: the counted domain is maximally generic. The hamza gives the totality phrase a small catch in the sound, fitting the claim that each discrete entity is included.

topics.headline: indefinite complement opens totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the universal phrase stays unbounded because the complement is indefinite.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the genitive complement of the quantifier.

topics.headline: thingness reaches any conceivable entity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the most generic possible object of enumeration, while will/existence associations remain secondary.
topics.reason: The root field supports broad thingness, but local syntax does not require a full metaphysical expansion.

topics.headline: totality formula has a glottal catch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both the familiar totality formula and the small sound break inside the claim of discrete inclusion.
topics.reason: The rows connect the phrase to broader totality usage and add a local prosodic payoff.

words.prose: {{ar:أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:aḥṣaynāhu}}) changes aspect after the imperfect reviving and writing verbs: the universal enumeration is presented as completed. Its suffix gathers {{ar:كُلَّ شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:kulla shayʾin}}) back into the verb as one total object. The ḥ-ṣ-y field sharpens the act beyond ordinary writing into precise exhaustive computation, with the pebble-counting image making each entity feel individually accounted for. The construction matches 78:29 and is answered by the all-capturing record of 18:49; in 36:12 the count is lodged in {{ar:إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ}} ({{tr:imāmin mubīn}}).

topics.headline: perfect verb presents count as complete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that enumeration is already completed even while reviving and writing are expressed as ongoing.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect first-person plural Form IV verb, preserving the divine subject with changed aspect.

topics.headline: suffix gathers the fronted totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the fronted universal phrase folded back into the verb by the object suffix.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the suffix as resuming the fronted object.

topics.headline: enumeration is precise and exhaustive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from recording entries to computing every thing with exact, individual precision.
topics.reason: The root and Form IV rows support exhaustive enumeration rather than a partial tally or ordinary writing.

topics.headline: total-enumeration formula joins record passages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the near-verbatim total count of 78:29 and the omits-nothing record of 18:49 behind this verb.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete references and fit the local formula with every thing.

topics.headline: hamza arrests the totality clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the glottal catch as the clause moves from every thing to the decisive count.
topics.reason: The sound row adds local prosodic payoff without changing grammar.

words.prose: {{ar:فِىٓ}} ({{tr:fī}}) turns the closing phrase into containment rather than instrument. The enumeration is not done by the register as a tool; it is lodged in {{ar:إِمَامٍ}} ({{tr:imāmin}}) as its containing place. The attachment can be discussed as touching the act of enumeration and the total object, but local syntax most directly connects the prepositional phrase to {{ar:أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:aḥṣaynāhu}}). The long vowel and pivot position slow the move into the final register phrase.

topics.headline: enumeration is lodged in a container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the record relation is spatialized as containment, not surface inscription or instrumentality.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence govern the following noun with the preposition and frame the register as containment.

topics.headline: attachment ambiguity is locally constrained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase can be felt as containing the counted totality, while syntax attaches it most directly to the enumeration verb.
topics.reason: The row raises a real scope question, but attachment evidence favors relation to the verb while still allowing the object to be the content lodged there.

topics.headline: preposition pivots into closure

words.prose: {{ar:إِمَامٍ}} ({{tr:imāmin}}) is governed by {{ar:فِىٓ}} ({{tr:fī}}) and then qualified by {{ar:مُّبِينٍ}} ({{tr:mubīnin}}). Its indefiniteness introduces the register by function and quality rather than by prior familiarity. The ʾ-m-m field makes the container more than a storage book: it can be a leading, source-like record to which things are referred, even a source-document from which derivative accountability proceeds. That range must be locally narrowed to the register phrase, yet the substitution for the writing term in 78:29 matters: 36:12 closes not with bare writing but with an authoritative leading record. The contrast with Abraham as an imām in 2:124 preserves the shared function of an imām as something followed or referred to.

topics.headline: indefinite register is qualified by clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the register is introduced as a kind of container and immediately specified by its making-clear quality.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence govern the noun with the preposition and bind the following adjective to it.

topics.headline: record is leading and source-like
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that imām language makes the register authoritative and referential, while local grammar keeps it as the containing record rather than a human leader.
topics.reason: The semantic range includes leader, guide, exemplar, source, and register; local containment narrows the active branch to authoritative source-record.

topics.headline: imām replaces kitāb in the total-count formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 78:29 uses writing language where 36:12 uses imām language, upgrading the archive into a leading source-record; 2:124 shows the shared function of what is followed or referred to.
topics.reason: The intertext rows give concrete references and preserve the lexical contrast without overriding the local register sense.

words.prose: {{ar:مُّبِينٍ}} ({{tr:mubīnin}}) is not a free-floating predicate; agreement locks it to {{ar:إِمَامٍ}} ({{tr:imāmin}}). The b-y-n field makes clarity active: the register is readable, but it also separates, sorts, and manifests what has been counted. Pairing {{ar:مُّبِينٍ}} ({{tr:mubīnin}}) with {{ar:إِمَامٍ}} ({{tr:imāmin}}) specializes the familiar clear-book field into a leading-record phrase. As the final word, it answers the emphatic opening with manifestation, joins Ya Sin's clarity thread at 36:17, 36:24, 36:47, 36:60, 36:69, and 36:77, and creates a boundary tension with 36:11: forgiveness covers, while this register makes the preserved account clear.

topics.headline: clarity belongs to the register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that manifestness modifies the register itself, not every thing or the act of enumeration in isolation.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word an agreeing adjective for the preceding noun.

topics.headline: active participle makes the record manifest
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices clarity as an active sorting and disclosing function, not only passive visibility.
topics.reason: The Form IV active participle and root field support making clear, separation, and manifestation.

topics.headline: manifest closure frames the ayah and surah thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with asserted divine agency and ends with a manifesting register, while the same clarity vocabulary recurs at 36:17, 36:24, 36:47, 36:60, 36:69, and 36:77.
topics.reason: The rows connect the final word to the clear-book formula field, repeated Ya Sin clarity language, and the boundary with 36:11.

baseline_models.mechanism: The paired first-person plural verbs join reversal of death to durable fixation: persons are restored while what they did remains available for judgment rather than dying with them.

activation_trace.role: Possession of animacy supplies the state restored by نحي and makes revival a reversal of lost life.
Loss of force and life supplies the terminal condition that the preceding verb reverses.
Fixation that entails judgment or decree makes writing an operative preservation, not casual notation.

changed_reading.before: The ayah separately promises resurrection and says that deeds are recorded.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection and evidentiary preservation form one mechanism: death does not erase either the actor or the action's judicial availability.

baseline_models.mechanism: The object pair distinguishes what agents intentionally place ahead from signs and paths that remain after them, so the writing captures both intervention and downstream wake.

activation_trace.role: Forward movement and precedence give قدموا a directional role: acts are projected ahead of their makers.
A surviving sign that indicates a prior event supplies the durable aftermath paired with forward action.
Following a predecessor's track makes an أثر a traversable route that can recruit later movement.
Joining one thing to another makes the record a dossier coupling initiating acts with their residual effects.

changed_reading.before: The record contains deeds and a second category called traces.
changed_reading.after: The record is causal and directional, coupling what a person sends forward with the signs, routes, and effects that continue behind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
baseline_models.mechanism: Totality is made countable and organized inside a clear origin, reference, and guide; the container is therefore a master index that exposes relations among items rather than a heap of entries.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing all parts supplies the claim that no component falls outside the register.
Whatever can be known and reported supplies the maximally general class of indexed objects.
Counting with exhaustive acquisition makes enumeration both quantitative and epistemically comprehensive.
An origin, gathering center, and reference supplies the register's organizing center.
A leader, book, road, or construction guide supplies an authoritative pattern by which entries can be followed.
Disclosure through speech, writing, or sign makes the master index readable and evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: Everything is stored in a clear book.
changed_reading.after: Everything is exhaustively indexed in an authoritative, legible reference-pattern that orders and reveals the relations among things.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated front/behind constructions turn قدموا and آثارهم into opposite sides of a traversed causal field: agents put acts before themselves while leaving consequences and followable tracks behind, even when perception of that field is blocked.

activation_trace.role: Advancing to the front supplies the forward pole of the focus pair.
A remaining indicator of what was supplies the rearward residue of the focus pair.
The idiom between the hands supplies an explicit frontward zone in which movement can be obstructed.
Barriers that close a gap make front and rear into bounded regions whose paths can be hidden.
What lies behind supplies the explicit rearward counterpart to between the hands.
The repeated frontward idiom makes the spatial pairing a surah-level organizing cue rather than a local accident.
The repeated behind-position stabilizes the second pole as aftermath and exposure.

structural_cues: 36:9 places barriers both between their hands and behind them, then states that they do not see.
36:45 repeats the paired warning about what is between their hands and what is behind them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated front/behind zones, hands, barriers, and the focus roots for advance and trace; I assign قدموا to frontward deposit and آثار to rearward wake. A live alternative reads both zones temporally as prior and coming consequences rather than spatially.

changed_reading.before: Prior deeds and later effects are two temporal entries.
changed_reading.after: They are the front and rear of one causal passage: action is placed ahead, while a readable wake remains behind and may guide or expose others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The town narrative stages a relay in which a sent message is followed, carried by purposeful movement, voiced publicly, and offered for further following; an أثر can therefore be a social route that survives its initiating speaker.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of a report until it becomes received tradition supplies the durable verbal trace.
Movement on a predecessor's track supplies the mechanism of imitation and relay.
Purposeful motion toward an objective makes the man's arrival an enacted extension of the message.
Speech that circulates among people supplies the propagating medium of the trace.
Tracing أثر after أثر makes the command to follow a literal social continuation mechanism.
Messenger and message name the dispatched content whose reception can generate a chain of followers.

structural_cues: 36:13-21 moves from dispatched messengers to a man arriving from the city's farthest point and urging others to follow them.
36:25-27 lets the man's voiced commitment outlive the confrontation and turns his concern back toward his people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending, purposeful movement, public speech, and explicit following; I infer a causal arrow from one reception to later uptake, so the focus trace includes propagated conduct. A live alternative limits آثار to the man's own steps and words without subsequent imitation.

changed_reading.before: Traces are unspecified residual consequences of deeds.
changed_reading.after: Traces include transmissible speech and modeled conduct that move through a community after the first speaker's action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dead-earth sequence renders revival as restoration of productive capacity: a dormant substrate is enlivened, hidden grain emerges, and fruit and further growth become its آثار. Resurrection is thus not bare animation but release of an interrupted causal yield.

activation_trace.role: Earth living through rain and vegetation supplies the focus verb with a productive ecological image.
Unworked dead land supplies a reversible kind of death whose contrast is renewed usefulness.
Soft productive earth supplies the material substrate in which restored life becomes visible.
The explicit dead-earth occurrence realizes the focus branch as an observable state rather than abstraction.
The repeated revival verb directly converts dead land into a producing system.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies emergence as the first output of revival.
A seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies a compact carrier of continuing effects.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the downstream yield by which revived capacity is known.
Intentional work places human action inside the productive chain whose outputs are recorded.
Vegetation emerging from earth generalizes the revived field into a repeatable growth process.

structural_cues: 36:33 repeats the focus's dead/revive pair and immediately sequences emergence, grain, and eating.
36:34-36 expands the output chain through gardens, water, fruit, hands' work, and all that earth causes to grow.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dead earth, revival, emergence, seed, fruit, work, and growth; I infer that productive outputs function as the revived substrate's traces. A live alternative treats the sequence solely as an analogy proving bodily resurrection, without importing productivity into the focus wording.

changed_reading.before: Reviving the dead means restoring animation to lifeless persons.
changed_reading.after: Revival restores suppressed productive capacity, and the record follows that return through the harvest of effects it releases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured stations, stable destinations, and non-colliding cycles activate the clear imam as a coordinate-pattern: enumeration can preserve where a moving thing belongs along its path, not merely whether it exists.

activation_trace.role: Exhaustive counting supplies the quantitative operation needed to track stations and cycles.
A guiding book, road, or construction line supplies the master pattern for ordered trajectories.
Continuous flowing motion supplies a trajectory rather than a static inventory item.
Fixity and settled position supply an assigned destination within the moving system.
Deliberate apportioning and planning supply the rule that coordinates motion and station.
A station or rank supplies discrete positions through which the lunar path is indexed.
Ancient elapsed time supplies historical depth inside the recurring measured cycle.
Each member under an encompassing whole makes the ordered system distributive as well as total.
The celestial course supplies the spatial track on which each indexed body moves.
Running or swimming supplies sustained motion within, rather than outside, the assigned course.

structural_cues: 36:38-39 joins running, a settled destination, apportioning, lunar stations, return, and antiquity.
36:40 prevents one cycle from overtaking another and places each member in a course.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured stations, destinations, recurring age, and distinct courses; I infer that الإمام is a master coordinate-pattern capable of locating trajectories. A live alternative keeps it a judicial ledger and uses the cosmic sequence only as evidence of exhaustive knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The clear imam is a static comprehensive ledger.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as a calibrated master map that indexes moving entities by course, station, sequence, and recurrence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carrying of descendants in a filled vessel and the creation of further mounts activate آثار as embodied legacy plus the material carriers that move it beyond the originating generation.

activation_trace.role: A surviving remainder that indicates prior existence supplies legacy as an embodied sign of predecessors.
Following a prior route supplies intergenerational continuation along an inherited path.
What is carried in lineage supplies descendants as a continuity borne beyond their predecessors.
Smallness coupled with dispersal supplies a branching image for descendants spreading from an origin.
A vessel moving through water supplies the material carrier of intergenerational continuity.
Filling and loading make continuity depend on a carrier stocked with living consequence.
Composing one thing into another supplies designed conveyances as extensions of human reach.

structural_cues: 36:41 names their descendants as what is carried in the filled vessel.
36:42 extends the carrying pattern to created analogues that people ride.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descendants, carrying, a loaded vessel, and composed mounts; I infer that people leave آثار through both lineage and transport infrastructures that carry futures. A live alternative restricts the passage to divine rescue and does not classify either descendants or vehicles as the people's traces.

changed_reading.before: A person's traces are mostly intangible consequences or remembered signs.
changed_reading.after: Traces can also be embodied continuities and material carriers through which a generation's reach travels beyond it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and exact recompense culminate in sealed mouths, speaking hands, and witnessing feet; the writing is activated as a distributed evidentiary dossier whose signs remain in agents and actions, not only in an external document.

activation_trace.role: Fixation that entails judgment supplies the dossier's legally operative record.
A remaining sign that proves what occurred supplies the evidentiary trace borne into judgment.
Joining dispersed items into one collected whole supplies the assembly of actors and evidence.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the adjudicative use of the collected record.
Intentional action supplies the conduct against which recompense is matched.
A seal and its imprint disable ordinary testimony while foregrounding an evidentiary mark.
Intelligible speech connecting parties turns the hands into direct reporting surfaces.
What the hands acquired ties bodily agency to the deeds now speaking through it.
A sign that itself bears witness makes the bodily remainder function as evidence.
The bodily foot supplies the organ that physically traversed and now attests to the path.
Acquisitive limbs supply bodily instruments whose own activity can remain legible.

structural_cues: 36:53-54 gathers everyone and limits recompense to what they used to do.
36:65 transfers testimony from sealed mouths to hands and feet concerning acquired conduct.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, deed-matched recompense, sealing, speaking hands, and witnessing feet; I infer that divine writing is distributed through embodied and material signs as well as a separate register. A live alternative keeps the written record and limb testimony as two independent evidentiary channels.

changed_reading.before: God keeps an external ledger later consulted at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The ledger is also distributed through durable imprints of agency: bodies, paths, and acquisitions become a dossier capable of testifying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah brackets the focus with a person who follows the reminder and a clear recitation that warns whoever is alive; revival acquires a present epistemic register in which life is capacity to receive warning and convert it into following.

activation_trace.role: Life as benefit and rescue supplies a non-metabolic dimension of the focus's reviving action.
Coming after and following supplies the behavioral response by which received warning becomes visible.
A reminder that makes something present supplies the stimulus to which receptive life responds.
The repeated reminder supplies the content explicitly identified with the clear recitation.
Reading and recitation supply the audible-textual vehicle by which warning reaches the living.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign makes the warning cognitively available.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the activating event rather than mere information transfer.
Life as operative good allows the explicit living addressee to activate a responsive sense alongside biological life.

structural_cues: 36:11 defines the effective addressee as one who follows the reminder and fears without seeing.
36:69-70 identifies the discourse as clear reminder and recitation whose warning reaches whoever is alive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reminder, following, disclosed recitation, awakening warning, and an explicit living addressee; I infer that responsiveness is a present mode of life and nonresponse a death-like incapacity. A live alternative takes حي in 36:70 as no more than ordinary biological life.

changed_reading.before: We revive the dead refers only to future bodily resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Without displacing bodily resurrection, the wording also resonates with present restoration of receptive, warning-responsive life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves from decayed bone through first origination and a green-tree/fire transformation to willing command and immediate coming-to-be. This activates the exhaustive clear imam as a prospective specification from which a dispersed or degraded form can be reconstituted, not only a retrospective archive.

activation_trace.role: Fixation as decree or determination supplies a record that can govern outcomes prospectively.
Exhaustive acquisition by enumeration supplies enough specification for no component to be lost.
An origin, gathering center, and reference supplies the prospective source from which a whole may be restored.
A book or construction guide supplies a pattern capable of directing reconstitution.
Decay and worn remains supply the degraded state whose informational continuity is questioned.
Bringing a thing newly into existence supplies origination as the demonstrated reconstruction capacity.
The first beginning supplies the prior realization used as the model for renewed creation.
Fresh green growth supplies a living material state that can disclose an apparently contrary outcome.
Kindled fire supplies the latent transformed output drawn from the green substrate.
An obligating command supplies the executable transition from specification to outcome.
Will and intention supply the initiating selection of the thing to be realized.
Will directed toward a thing links the indexed object to prospective realization.
Uttered saying supplies the expressed command that mediates the transition.
A thing's occurring and becoming present in time supplies realization of the commanded specification.

structural_cues: 36:78-79 answers the problem of decayed bones by appealing to first origination and comprehensive knowledge of every creation.
36:80 supplies a cross-state transformation from green tree to kindled fire.
36:82 compresses willing, saying, and becoming into a directional sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decay, first origination, comprehensive knowledge, a counterintuitive material transformation, will, command, and becoming; I infer that the focus's fixed and exhaustive imam can function like a generative specification. The materially live alternative is a purely retrospective judicial ledger plus independent creative power.

changed_reading.before: The clear imam preserves a complete archive of what already exists and happened.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also a complete generative reference by which a lost form can be called back into realized existence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's secondary mapped inventory for ء ث ر, whose images concern outward emergence and stirring rather than the dominant lexical trace inventory. It remains valid as an explicitly supplied split-root activation anchored to آثارهم and coordinated with قدموا; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory resonance, never as a replacement etymology or lexical equation.

activation_trace.role: Forward advance supplies the initiating projection from which an outward wake can proceed.
Visible emergence and outward spread recast the trace as an emitted wake rather than only residue.
Stirring something from its place supplies a dynamic effect that moves other things after the initiating act.

changed_reading.before: Their آثار are static marks left after completed actions.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their آثار are wakes launched by forward acts: effects stirred into motion and spreading outward from the agent.

strongest_changes: The forward-deed/remaining-trace pair became a front-and-rear causal field that includes routes others can follow.
Revival became productive restoration, visible in emergence, seed, fruit, and renewed capacity, while retaining bodily resurrection.
Writing became a distributed evidentiary dossier in which seals, hands, feet, acquisitions, and material signs can testify.
The clear imam became legible as an ordering pattern for trajectories and, more exploratorily, a generative reference for re-creation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly externalized the focus ayah's compressed relations: front/behind space, messenger-to-follower relay, dead-earth growth, calibrated celestial courses, carried descendants, embodied witnesses, responsive life, and first creation followed by commanded becoming.
remaining_uncertainties: The coordinate-pattern and generative-specification readings of الإمام are abductive and may reduce to an exhaustive judicial ledger.
It remains uncertain whether descendants and conveyances are themselves آثار or only analogies for effects that outlast an agent.
The responsive sense of life in 36:70 may coexist with, but should not displace, its ordinary biological sense.
The split-root outward-wake activation is deliberately contained as branch-supplied resonance rather than lexical derivation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The record joins act to surviving trace.** `ك ت ب` B001 is joining and B002 joins letters into writing; `ق د م` B004 is forward precedence; `ء ث ر` B003 is a remaining sign pointing to what was. The coordination explicitly binds prior deeds and aftereffects, while 36:65 later lets limbs testify to acquisition. I infer that inscription preserves causal continuity between an act and what outlives it. The writing reads as relational accounting, not a flat list.
2. **A guiding matrix, not only a ledger.** `ح ص ي` B002 counts until encompassing; `ء م م` B002 is source and reference, while B009 is a followed guide; `ب ي ن` B004 makes clear. The packet later displays measured courses (36:38-40) and exact recompense (36:54). I infer that comprehensive enumeration serves both retrospective record and prospective ordering. The clear *imam* can therefore be read as an encompassing reference-pattern.
3. **Revival reactivates apparently dead effects.** `ح ي ي` B003 is animate life and B013 life as saving benefit; `م و ت` B012 is still inactivity. Because traces are written after mention of reviving the dead, I infer that resurrection also makes dormant consequences operative. The ayah reads as reactivation of persons and their causal histories.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:65's hand-and-foot testimony made the record bodily, and 36:79's comprehensive knowledge supplied a mechanism for preserving created measure through decay. The *imam* became both ledger and recoverable pattern.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A joined record reassembles deed and aftermath.** **ك ت ب B001** (“joining one thing to another”) underlies **نَكْتُبُ**; **ق د م B004** supplies beforeward advance in **قَدَّمُوا۟**; **ء ث ر B003** supplies the remaining sign in **ءَاثَٰرَهُمْ**; and **ح ص ي B002** supplies exhaustive encompassing count. The fixed coordination joins what agents send ahead to what remains behind them, while 36:9 had spatially opposed ahead and behind. The packet gives both poles and their inscription; the abduction is *recording stitches action to propagated consequence so neither can be isolated*. The ayah reads as causal accounting, not a flat list of entries.
2. **The manifest imam is both register and route-line.** **ء م م B009** permits **إِمَامٍ** to be a followed book, road, or construction line, and **ب ي ن B004** makes it visible/clear in **مُّبِينٍ**. The straight path of 36:4, the follower of 36:11, and the settlement example beginning in 36:13 are all packet-supplied within the window. The inferred arrow is *an encompassing record can guide because its ordered traces expose where acts lead*. The closing phrase consequently reads as a legible alignment-device as well as a repository.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** The town-example beginning at 36:13 makes the record operational: by 36:17, clear delivery has generated a traceable sequence of arrival, denial, and role separation. The “manifest imam” therefore reads as a guide through consequences, not a static archive.

baseline.text: Şüphesiz ölülere hayat veren biziz. Onların önceden yaptıklarını ve geride bıraktıkları izleri yazarız. Her şeyi apaçık bir kayıtta sayıp dökmüşüzdür.

findings.text: Kayıt, eylemi geride kalan etkisine yeniden bağlayarak kişinin yaptığıyla yaydığı sonucu birbirinden ayırmaz.
Apaçık kayıt, yalnızca geçmişi saklayan bir defter değil, eylemlerin nereye vardığını gösteren kuşatıcı bir başvuru çizgisidir.
Diriliş, kişilerin yanı sıra durmuş görünen sonuçlarını ve nedensel geçmişlerini de yeniden etkinleştirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Recovery of What Has Passed
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What has fallen out of active presence can be returned either to life or to a legible evidentiary state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The ledger is materially imagined as joined pieces, a roster, and pebbles counted one by one, making resurrection and record retrieval parallel operations of re-presentation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reactivating still life
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A state of lost force and sleep-like stillness is reversed into preserved or rain-like life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rain-revived earth (quranic:root_000383:B002/m01); life spared from killing (quranic:root_000383:B006/m01); loss of force and life (quranic:root_001454:B001/m01); stillness like sleep or decay (quranic:root_001454:B012/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Death is given both a terminal sense and a dormant, windless or sleep-like sense. Life answers it as preservation and as the return of fertility, so revival becomes a transition from arrested potential to active presence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Enrolling deeds and traces
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Acts sent ahead and marks left behind are joined into writing, entered in a roster, counted, and exposed by an authoritative guide-record.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: joining pieces into a whole (quranic:root_001283:B001/m01); ordered written characters (quranic:root_001283:B002/m01); binding decree (quranic:root_001283:B003/m01); entry in a register (quranic:root_001283:B004/m01); advance into the foreground (quranic:root_001207:B004/m01); surviving mark (quranic:root_000011:B003/m01); path of a predecessor's trace (quranic:root_000011:B004/m01); counting pebble (quranic:root_000332:B001/m01); exhaustive enumeration (quranic:root_000332:B002/m01); guiding exemplar and construction line (quranic:root_000053:B009/m01); disclosed evidence (quranic:root_000170:B004/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Forward acts and surviving traces occupy opposite temporal directions but converge in one evidentiary apparatus. Writing joins discrete units, the roster fixes identity, pebble-counting exhausts quantity, and the imam functions at once as guide, book, and line by which a structure is kept true.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı ölümün karşıtı olan canlılık durumu etrafında kurar; canlı kalmayı, yaşamın farklı güç ve düzeylerini, yeniden canlandırmayı ve ölümün düşünülemediği sürekli var oluşu da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşam durumunu ve onu başlatma ya da sürdürme işlemini kapsar; yağmur, karşılama sözü, utanma ve başka özel türevler ayrı dallarda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel yaşam ve canlı olma anlamlarıyla, canlı kalma, canlandırma ve özel türevlerde beliren kullanımlar birbirinden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Ölümün karşıtı olarak canlı olma ve canlı kalma durumudur; bir varlığı canlı kılma ya da yeniden canlandırma işlemini de kapsar. Bitkisel, duyusal ve düşünsel yaşam ile dünyadaki, sonraki ve ölmez var oluş bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın ölü olmayıp canlı bulunması ve yaşamını sürdürmesi temel anlamdır.
Canlı kılma veya ölümden sonra yeniden canlandırma, temel durumun ettirgen ve yenileyici uzantısıdır.
Bitkisel büyüme, duyum, düşünme, dünya yaşamı, sonraki yaşam ve ölmez var oluş, canlılığın kaynakta ayrılan özel düzeyleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ölüm karşıtı canlılık çekirdeğinde birleşir; toplu tanıklık ayrıca yaşamın güçlerini, sürekliliğini ve yeniden canlandırmayı bu çekirdeğin kapsamına alır.

error_profile.loses: Canlandırma işlemini ve yaşamın özel düzeylerini kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yağmuru toprağı yaşatan neden olarak adlandırır ve bu anlamı verimli toprak, taze bitki, yağmura kavuşan topluluk ve otlanan hayvanlarla somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal insanın genel yaşamını değil, yağmurun toprağa, bitkiye ve geçime getirdiği canlılık ile buna bağlı kalıpları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yağmur ve toprak canlılığına ilişkin temel adlandırma, toprağı verimli bulma ve bir topluluğun yağmurla ota kavuşması gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlardan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yağmurun toprağı canlandırması, verim ve taze bitki meydana getirmesidir; yağmurun kendisi de bu yaşatıcı etkiden ötürü adlandırılır. Toprağı bu durumda bulmak ve bir topluluğun yağmurla bol ota kavuşması yapıya bağlı uzantılardır.

facets.statement: Yağmur, toprağa canlılık verdiği ve onu ölüm görünümünden çıkardığı için bu adla anılır.
Verimli toprak ile taze ve hareketli bitki, yağmurun yaşatıcı etkisinin görünür sonuçlarıdır.
Toprağı verimli bulmak veya bir topluluğun yağmur ve bol ota kavuşması yalnız belirli yapılarda anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yağmurun toprağı canlandırdığı konusunda birleşir; verim, taze bitki ve hayvanların otla güçlenmesi bu etkinin sonuçları olarak aktarılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yağmuru ve verimli sonucu adlandırır; komşu dal bitkinin çıkış ve büyüme sürecini adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün yağmur, toprak ve bitki adayları değerlendirildi; karşıt kuraklık ile bahar ve bitki çıkışı sınırları en açıklayıcı üç karşılaştırma olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحيا بمعنى المطر، وخصب الأرض، والنبات الطري، وإحياء الأرض أو إصابة القوم بالمطر والمرعى.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يضم مطلق الحياة الآدمية أو الأخروية إلا من جهة أن المطر سبب الحياة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: يسمى المطر حيا لأن به حياة الأرض (maqayis); الحيا مقصور حيا الربيع وهو ما تحيا به الأرض من الغيث (ayn); أحيا القوم أي صاروا في الحيا وهو الخصب وأتيت الأرض فأحييتها أي وجدتها خصبة (sihah); الحي من النبات ما كان طريا يهتز والحيا الغيث (tahdhib); الحيا المطر لأنه يحيي الأرض بعد موتها (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın yönü ruh, duyum veya canlılık taşıyan varlıktır; ancak aynı ifade ayrıca bitmeyen gerçek yaşamı da ayrı bir kullanım olarak verir. Dal korunabilir, fakat varlık adı ile sonsuz yaşam okuması tek bir çekirdekmiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana okuma canlı varlıktır; bitmeyen gerçek yaşam kaynakta bulunan ayrı bir anlam değişkesi olarak tutulur, genel yaşam durumu ise B001'e bırakılır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel biçimin canlı varlık anlamı tanımın merkezidir; aynı biçimin bitmeyen yaşam okuması bağımsız bir kaynak değişkesi olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Ruh, duyum veya canlılık taşıyan varlığı anlatır ve ölü cansız varlığın karşısında durur. Aynı biçim kaynakta ayrıca bitmeyen gerçek yaşam için kullanıldığından bu ikinci okuma ayrı tutulmalıdır.

facets.statement: Ruh, duyum veya yaşam taşıyan her canlı varlık temel kapsamı oluşturur.
Bitmeyen gerçek yaşam okuması, canlı varlık adından ayrılması gereken ikinci bir kaynak kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık canlı varlık ve ölüm karşıtlığı üzerinde yoğunlaşır; aynı kaynak kümesi biçimi kalıcı gerçek yaşam için de kullandığından iki okuma bağlamla ayrılmalıdır.

concept_gloss.text: canlı varlık veya bitmeyen gerçek yaşam
concept_gloss.applicability: Kaynakta aynı biçime bağlanan iki ayrı okumayı birleştirmeden gösteren kapsayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Canlı varlık çekirdeğini ve bitmeyen yaşam değişkesini ayrı seçenekler olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ruh, duyum veya canlılık taşıyan bir varlıktan söz edildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dalın baskın canlı varlık okumasını eksiksiz verir.
error_profile.loses: Bitmeyen gerçek yaşam biçimindeki kaynak değişkesini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Biçimin kalıcı ve yok olmayan yaşamı anlattığı özel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıcı yaşam değişkesini açıkça korur.
error_profile.loses: Canlı varlık sınıfını bildiren ana okumayı kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: canlı varlık, özellikle duyup hareket eden varlık

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ruh veya duyum taşıyan bütün canlı varlıklar ile bitmeyen yaşam değişkesi bu dalın geniş kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayırt etme yetisi bulunmayan ve özellikle dört ayaklı canlı sınıfı komşu dalın daraltıcı özelliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: canlı varlık ile ayırt etmeyen canlı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insan dışı canlıları kapsayabilen varlık adlarıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal canlı varlığı genel olarak adlandırır; komşu dal canlılar içinden ayırt etme yetisi bulunmayan belirli sınıfı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlılığı taşıyan bütün varlığın kendisi bu dalın odağıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bedeni yaşattığı düşünülen öz ve onun bedenden çıkışı komşu dalın odağıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bedenin canlı olması ve ölümle ilişkisi çevresinde birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal canlı bireyi adlandırır; komşu dal o bireyin yaşam ilkesi sayılan özü adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her tür ruh veya duyum taşıyan canlı bu dalın kapsamına girebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yılan türünün adı ve bu ada bağlı özel türevler komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Yılan da canlı bir varlık olduğu için iki dalın gönderimleri kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal üst sınıfı anlatır; komşu dal o sınıf içindeki belirli canlı türünü adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; canlıların alt sınıfı, bedeni yaşatan öz ve yılan türü üst sınıf-alt sınıf karışıklıklarını en iyi gösteren adaylardı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحيوان وكل ذي روح، والحية الأهلية في الحديث بمعنى كل نفس أو دابة، وما يقابل الموتان.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يضم الحية الثعبان كاسم جنس مستقل إلا إذا كان الكلام عن كونها دابة حية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحيوان كل ذي روح (ayn); الحيوان خلاف الموتان (sihah); الحيوان اسم يقع على كل شيء حي وكل ذي روح حيوان (tahdhib); الحيوان مقر الحياة وما له الحاسة وما له البقاء الأبدي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi erkek ve dişi için kullanılan genel yılan adını ve erkek yılan için özel biçimi açıkça destekler. Bununla birlikte adın yaşam kökünden mi yoksa sarılma düşüncesinden mi geldiği konusunda iki türetme bulunduğundan köken bağı kesinleştirilemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yılan adlandırmasını korur; yaşamla türetme yalnız bir açıklamadır ve sarılma temelli karşı açıklama dışlanmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yılan adı çekirdekte tutulur; erkek yılan, yılan bakıcısı ve yılanlı yer gibi özel biçimler yalnız kendi sözcük sınırlarında yorumlanır.

concept_map.definition: Erkek veya dişi olabilen yılan için kullanılan genel addır; erkek yılan için ayrıca özel bir adlandırma bulunur. Adın yaşam düşüncesinden türediği açıklaması, sarılma düşüncesine dayanan karşı açıklamayla birlikte ve kesinleştirilmeden verilmelidir.

facets.statement: Genel yılan adı hem erkek hem dişi birey için kullanılabilir.
Erkek yılan için ayrı bir özel biçim kaynakta açıkça tanıklanır.
Yılan adının yaşamdan türetilmesi ile sarılıp kıvrılmadan türetilmesi birbirine rakip iki açıklamadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar genel yılan adı ve erkek yılan için özel biçim üzerinde birleşir; köken açıklaması ise yaşam ile sarılıp kıvrılma arasında kesinleştirilemeyen bir ayrılık gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Genel tür adını, erkek birey adını ve bu alandaki türevleri kapsayan doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yılan çekirdeğini, cinsiyet ayrımını ve ilişkili adlandırma alanını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Özel biçimin yılanın erkek bireyini gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Cinsiyete bağlı özel adlandırmanın gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Her iki cinsiyeti kapsayan genel tür adını ve köken tartışmasını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her iki cinsiyeti kapsayan genel yılan adı ve ona bağlı türevler bu dalın kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir yılan çeşidi, özellikle beyaz yılan okuması komşu dalın dar kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel yılan ile özel yılan türü
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğrudan yılan türünden bir canlıyı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel tür adıdır; komşu dal yılanlar içinde belirli bir çeşide verilen addır ve genel karşılık olarak kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Boyut veya biçim sınırlaması olmadan genel yılan adı bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İrilik, kötücüllük, kısalık veya yuvarlaklık gibi niteliklerle tanımlanan özel yılan komşu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yılanı doğrudan gönderim konusu yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bütün yılanlara açık genel addır; komşu dal belirli görünüş veya nitelikteki yılanı adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün yılan adları değerlendirildi; genel tür adıyla belirli yılan çeşitleri arasındaki sınırı en açık gösteren iki aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحية للذكر والأنثى، والحيوت ذكر الحيات، والنسبة والصاحب المتعامل مع الحيات عند من يشتقه من هذا الباب.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يضم تفسير الحية من حويت والالتواء إلا بوصفه اشتقاقا بديلا خارج هذا الفرع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الحية معروف يقال حية ذكر وحية أنثى والحيوت ذكر الحيات (jamhara); الحية اشتقاقها من الحياة (ayn); الحية تكون للذكر والأنثى والحيوت ذكر الحيات (sihah); اشتقاق الحية من الحياة ومن قال حواء قال من حويت لأنها تتحوى (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi utanmayı yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı olarak verir ve kişinin kötü görülen davranışlardan içsel bir daralma nedeniyle kaçınmasını temel anlam sayar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içsel utanma ve kötüden çekinmeyle sınırlıdır; öldürmeyip sağ bırakma anlamındaki benzer biçim bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel utanma adı ile bir kişiden veya davranıştan utanmayı bildiren yapılar ayrı dil bilgisel gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kötü, uygunsuz veya yüz kızartıcı gördüğü şey karşısında içten daralması ve bu nedenle ondan kaçınmasıdır; yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı olarak değerlendirilir.

facets.statement: Kötü görülen şey karşısında duyulan içsel daralma ve utanma temel duygudur.
Bu duygu kişiyi kötü davranışı bırakmaya veya ondan uzak durmaya yöneltir.
Bir kişiden veya onun karşısında yapılan bir şeyden utanma, duygunun katılımcısı belirtilmiş kullanım biçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar utanmayı yüzsüzlüğün karşıtı, kötü davranış karşısındaki içsel daralma ve o davranışı bırakmaya yönelten duygu olarak birlikte tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duyguyu ve bu duygunun davranışı durdurucu sonucunu birlikte veren temel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İçsel utanmayı, kötüyle ilişkisini ve çekinme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Utanma duygusunun yöneldiği kişi veya neden açıkça belirtildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Utanma duygusunu ve yöneldiği katılımcıyı doğal biçimde verir.
error_profile.loses: Duygunun kötü davranışı bırakmaya yönelten genel işlevini açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ondan utandı ya da konuşmasına karşılık vermedi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kötü görülen şey karşısındaki içsel daralma ve davranıştan çekinme bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Birini öldürmeyip sağ bırakma kararı komşu dalın tek çekirdeğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal benzer sözcük yapılarıyla ifade edilir, fakat anlam çekirdekleri ortak değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir duygu ve davranışsal çekinme bildirir; komşu dal ise bir kişinin yaşamına son vermeme eylemini bildirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dış adaylar anlam alanını kesmiyordu, benzer biçimli sağ bırakma dalı ise en güçlü yanlış anlamayı oluşturduğu için tek ayrım olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحياء، والاستحياء، وحييت منه أو من فعل، والانقباض عن القبائح، وترك القبيح في حق الله عند تفسير الصفة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يضم الاستبقاء وترك القتل في مثل يستحيون نساءكم، ولا العضو المسمى حياء إلا من جهة التسمية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الاستحياء الذي هو ضد الوقاحة واستحييت منه (maqayis); حييت عن فلان إذا استحييت عنه (jamhara); حييت منه أحيا استحييت واستحياه واستحيا منه من الحياء (sihah); الحياء من الاستحياء ورجل حيي واستحيا الرجل (tahdhib); الحياء انقباض النفس عن القبائح وتركه (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çoğunluğu kadınları veya gençleri sağ bırakıp öldürmemeyi açıkça destekler. Buna karşılık toplu aktarımdaki bir parça bunun tersini söyleyen eksik ya da bozuk bir olumsuzluk içerdiğinden dal ancak bu metinsel karşıtlık belirtilerek kabul edilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım öldürmeyip sağ bırakma okumasını izler; karşıt yöndeki tek olumsuz aktarım kaynak içi uyuşmazlık olarak korunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız belirli kişileri sağ bırakmayı bildiren türemiş yapıdadır; temel biçime genel bir utanma veya yaşam anlamı olarak taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kadınları, gençleri veya başka belirli kişileri öldürmeyip sağ bırakmaktır. Kaynakların baskın açıklaması bu yöndedir; tek bir karşıt olumsuz aktarım tanımın parçası değil, metinsel uyuşmazlıktır.

facets.statement: Öldürme imkânı veya tehdidi altında bulunan kişileri öldürmeyip canlı bırakmak temel işlemdir.
Kadınlar ve bir topluluğun gençleri kaynakta açıkça belirtilen kişi gruplarıdır.
Toplu aktarımın bir bölümündeki karşıt olumsuzluk, baskın sağ bırakma açıklamasıyla uyuşmayan metinsel bir değişkedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıtın baskın yönü belirli kişileri sağ bırakmak ve öldürmemektir; aynı toplu iddiadaki tek karşıt olumsuzluk, kaynaklara ayrı ayrı bağlanamayan bir uyuşmazlık olarak not edilmelidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişilerin yaşamına son verilmeyip korunması anlamındaki türemiş yapıya uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Öldürmeme işlemini ve kişinin canlı kalması sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadınların öldürülmeyip canlı bırakıldığı tarihsel veya anlatısal bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öldürmeme işlemini ve kadınların canlı kalması sonucunu açıkça verir.
error_profile.loses: Gençler veya başka kişi grupları üzerindeki daha geniş uygulamayı kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir türemiş yapıda kadınları veya gençleri öldürmeme anlamı bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bağışlama, acıma ve sevgiyi sürdürme gerekçeleri komşu dalın daha geniş kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da güç yetirilen bir kişiyi yok etmeyip koruma sonucunda birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yapıya bağlı olarak öldürmeme ve canlı bırakmayı bildirir; komşu dal bağışlama, acıma ve ilişkiyi koruma gibi daha geniş gerekçeler taşıyabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Öldürme karşısında kişiyi canlı bırakma bu dalın zorunlu sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesneyi koruma, kişiye acıma ve verilen sözü gözetme komşu dalın ek kapsamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişi veya şeyin ortadan kalkmasını önleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğrudan yaşamı sona erdirmemeye bağlıdır; komşu dal yaşam dışındaki koruma ve söz gözetme durumlarına da uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bağışlayarak sağ bırakma ve daha genel koruma anlamları, bu yapının öldürmeme sınırını en iyi açıklayan iki yakın komşudur.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استحياء النساء أو الصغار بمعنى استبقائهم أحياء وترك قتلهم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يضم الحياء الخلقي أو الخجل، وإن اتحد اللفظ في استحيا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: ويستحيون نساءكم أي لا يستبقي (sihah); استحيوا شرخهم بمعنى استفعلوا من الحياة أي استبقوهم ولا تقتلوهم (tahdhib); ويستحيون نساءكم أي يستبقونهن (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana çizgisi insanlar arasında esenlik, yaşam ve kalıcılık dileği taşıyan karşılama sözüdür. Aynı ifade içinde egemenlik yorumu da geçtiği için bu yorum çekirdeğe katılmamalı, ayrı bir kaynak değişkesi ve B008 ile kesişen okuma olarak gösterilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılama, esenlik ve uzun ömür dileğine dayanır; egemenlik yorumu yalnız ayrı bir değişke olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel karşılama adı, yaşam ve esenlik dileyen kalıp ile bütün kalıcılığı yüce varlığa ayıran söz ayrı kullanımlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların birbirine esenlik, yaşam ve kalıcılık dilediği karşılama veya karşılık verme sözüdür. Bazı aktarımlarda aynı kalıp egemenlik bildirimi olarak yorumlandığından bu okuma ana anlamdan ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye yaşam, kalıcılık ve esenlik dilemek karşılama sözünün temel işlevidir.
İnsanların birbirini karşılaması ve esenlik sözünü karşılıklı iletmesi bu çekirdeğin toplumsal kullanımıdır.
Aynı sözün egemenlik bildirdiği yorumu, esenlik dileğinden ayrılması gereken bir kaynak değişkesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt karşılama sözünü yaşam, kalıcılık ve esenlik dileği olarak açıklar; aynı toplu iddia içindeki egemenlik yorumu ise kaynaklara ayrıştırılamayan karşıt bir açıklama oluşturur.

concept_gloss.text: esenlik, uzun ömür ve kalıcılık dileği
concept_gloss.applicability: Karşılama sözünün yaşam ve esenlik dileyen ana işlevini eksiksiz anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Esenlik dileğini, yaşamın sürmesini ve kalıcılık isteğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin diğerini karşılama sözüyle selamladığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı söz ve esenlik dileği işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Uzun ömür dileğinin bütün ayrıntılarını ve egemenlik değişkesini kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı sana yaşam, kalıcılık ve esenlik versin
yoruma göre bütün esenlik, kalıcılık ya da egemenlik Tanrı'nındır

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğrudan karşılama, uzun ömür dileği ve karşılıklı esenlik sözü bu dalın geniş kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir başkasının esenlik sözünü üçüncü kişiye aynen iletme komşu dalın özel işlemidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişiye esenlik bildiren sözlü davranışı kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi birkaç erkek kişi adını açıkça tanıklar ve bunlardan birinin yaşamla ilişkisini yanlış davranışların onu öldürmemesi düşüncesiyle açıklar. Adların yüzey biçimi yazar tarafından kurulmadan dal topluca tanımlanabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, canlıdaki gücün ve yaşamın sona ermesini çekirdek anlam olarak verir; ayrıca ölümün yaşamın karşıtı olduğunu ve yaşam türlerine göre ölüm türlerinin de ayrılabildiğini belirtir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu bileşenleri doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşamın sona ermesini anlatır; dilek, yalan veya okuma anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın anlamı hem de türemiş biçimlerle bir pekiştirme kalıbını içerir; kalıba özgü pekiştirme çekirdek ölüm anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Canlıdaki güç ve yaşamın sona ermesi, yani yaşam durumunun karşıtına geçmesidir. Ölüm türleri, söz konusu yaşam türlerine göre ayrılabilir.

facets.statement: Canlıdaki güç ve yaşam sona erer; bu durum yaşamın karşıtıdır.
Ölümün türleri, karşılık geldikleri yaşam türlerine göre ayrılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, ölümü yaşamın ve canlı gücünün sona ermesi olarak tanımlar. Toplu aktarım ayrıca bunun temel bir yaratılmış durum olduğunu ve farklı yaşam biçimlerine göre farklı ölüm türlerinden söz edilebildiğini bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı kullanımı açıkça destekler: bir canlıyı öldürmek veya bir şeyin gücünü gidermek ve pişirme yoluyla içkinin keskinliğini azaltmak. Dal çerçevesi bu ettirgen çekirdeği ve özel pişirme uygulamasını birbirine karıştırmadan korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, ölümün kendisini değil, ölüm veya güç kaybı meydana getiren ettirgen işlemi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam ettirgen biçimle pişirme kalıplarını birlikte içerir; pişirmeye bağlı keskinlik giderme anlamı her öldürme kullanımına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlıyı öldürmek veya bir şeyin gücünü ve keskinliğini gidermektir. Özel olarak, pişirme işlemiyle içkinin sertliğinin azaltılmasını da anlatır.

facets.statement: Ettirgen bir işlem, canlıda ölümü ya da bir şeyde güç kaybını meydana getirir.
Pişirme, içkinin keskinliğini ve etkisini azaltan özel gerçekleştirme yoludur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, ettirgen kullanımı bir canlıyı öldürme veya bir şeyin gücünü giderme olarak verir. Pişirme örneği bu çekirdeğin, içkinin keskinliğini azaltmaya özgü bir uygulamasıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ettirgen ölüm anlamını ve yalnızca belirtilen pişirme bağlamındaki güç azaltmayı birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hem ölümü meydana getirme işlemini hem de pişirmeyle gücü azaltma uzmanlaşmasını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem ruh taşımayan şeyleri hem de ekim ve iyileştirmeyle canlandırılmamış, sahipsiz veya kullanılmayan araziyi kapsar. Dal çerçevesi araziye özgü koşulları genel cansızlık alanından ayırarak doğru biçimde sunar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım yalnızca cansız şey ve işlenmemiş ya da sahipsiz arazi anlamlarını içerir, başka kalıplardan anlam almaz.
